en.title: Special DNA Substrings with a Single Middle Character
en.description:
For length 2, the two characters must be equal; for length greater than 2, the first and last characters must be equal and the middle must contain exactly one kind of character. Count all qualifying substrings by index.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: One line with a lowercase string of length 1..300000.
en.explanation: Example 1: yy and xyyx are valid, 2 in total. Example 2: 3 of length 2, 2 of length 3 and 1 of length 4, 6 in total. Example 3: one aa on each side plus aba in the middle, 3 in total.
hints: Use run-length encoding. A run of equal characters of length L contributes L(L−1)/2 internally. The case where the ends differ from the middle character corresponds exactly to three consecutive runs whose outer characters are equal, and each such middle run contributes 1.
